A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Conviction" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he scolded [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] and former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]] for getting into a [[Unarmed combat/Legends|fight]]. He was rotund, with [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and pale skin, and had a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of himself shaking hands with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] on his office wall.<ref name="Conviction" />
